title: crossword: scoreboard on launch, pre-made puzzle mode, fix scrollbars
body:
Adds three features to the crossword game: a localStorage-backed scoreboard shown before setup (when history exists), a "Pre-made Puzzle" mode pulling from `crossword/puzzles.json`, and eliminates the persistent scrollbar.

## Scoreboard
- Shown on first load if `localStorage['crosswordScoresV1']` is non-empty; skips straight to setup otherwise
- Displays top 20 completions sorted by fastest time: date, elapsed time, hints, board size, locked words, mode/puzzle name
- Scores written on victory; include `{ date, time, hints, size, locked, mode, name }`

## Pre-made Puzzle mode
- Mode selector added to setup: "Generate from Themes" (existing) or "Pre-made Puzzle"
- Puzzle mode swaps out the theme list and board-size slider for a picker listing all 16 puzzles from `puzzles.json` plus a "🎲 Random" option
- `puzzles.json` has no grid coordinates — across+down clues are extracted into a flat pool and passed through the existing `tryBuildDenseBoard()` algorithm; board size auto-selected based on pool size (≥50 words → 15)
- Fixed a JSON syntax error in `puzzles.json` line 78: `"number": 57]` → `"number": 57`
- `gameMode` and `puzzleName` persisted in `saveToLocalStorage` / hydrated on resume

## Scrollbar fix
- `html` element was missing `overflow-y: hidden` (body had it; root didn't), causing a 1px scrollbar
- Also corrected `showSetupMode()` which was restoring `setupScreen` as `display: block` instead of `display: flex`, breaking its internal flex layout
